findings.sourceReading: Beatrice says the barrier is being shaved or scraped away, compares the effort with shaving hard Parmigiano-Reggiano, and the narration repeats that the storm shaves the cylindrical wall down.
findings.alternative: Erased conveys progressive destruction and cutting hard cheese still suggests resistance, while the next line returns to shave.

findings.description: The maintained PS3-derived Japanese has only 添い遂げる, staying together as partners. MG's sleeping together on their first night and UP's consummate their love both preserve sexual specificity from the fuller original-PC clause 体を重ねることや、初めての夜を添い遂げること. This shared original-PC material is yellow and excluded from the translation-error count; the separate WH-parent disposition addresses the original English's success framing.
